title: Development environments for cloud agents · Cursor

facts.fact: Cursor's vendor-reported upgraded layer caching makes Dockerfile builds that hit the cache run 70% faster.
facts.quote: We've also upgraded layer caching, so that only the updated layers of your image rebuild when you change the Dockerfile. Builds that hit the cache run 70% faster.

facts.fact: Build secrets in Cursor's Dockerfile-based environment configuration are scoped to the build step and are not passed to the running agent's environment.
facts.quote: Build secrets are scoped to the build step and aren't passed to the running agent's environment.

facts.fact: Admins can restrict rollback permissions for Cursor development environments to admins only.
facts.quote: Admins can also restrict rollback permissions to admins only.

facts.fact: Cursor development environments include an audit log that captures every action team members take on environments.
facts.quote: An audit log captures every action team members take on environments, giving security teams full visibility into who changed what.

facts.fact: Secrets configured for one Cursor development environment are not accessible from any other development environment.
facts.quote: Secrets configured for one environment aren't accessible from any other.

facts.fact: If a Cursor cloud agent environment configuration fails, Cursor defaults to a base image with clear warning signs so cloud agents can keep running instead of immediately failing.
facts.quote: If your environment configuration fails, it will default to a base image with clear warning signs so that your cloud agents can keep running instead of immediately failing.

facts.fact: Cloud agents and automations in Cursor support multi-repo environments, allowing a single environment to contain all repositories an agent needs, with re-use across sessions.
facts.quote: Cloud agents and automations now support multi-repo environments, building off our work on multi-root workspaces. You can configure a single environment with all the repositories an agent needs for its work, with re-use across sessions.
